name: Hellfire Skull
primary:
A burning skull: fire and withering.
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 1.75 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Withering: −0.75 ❤ per second for 6.25 s
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 0.75 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 3.75 s
